description: Figure 1 illustrates the relationship between loss and the number of tokens processed, comparing a vanilla Transformer model to the proposed SepLLM model. The x-axis is labeled “Tokens” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at intervals of 0.10. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.80, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.  A red solid line represents the vanilla Transformer, starting at approximately 2.76 at x=0.00 and decreasing to approximately 2.51 at x=1.00. A blue dashed line represents SepLLM, starting at approximately 2.72 at x=0.00 and decreasing to approximately 2.42 at x=1.00. Both lines demonstrate a generally decreasing trend across the x-axis.
